target_customer: Micro and small local merchants in Southeast Asia and beyond who take orders by WhatsApp or phone
problem: Hundreds of millions of small businesses take orders over WhatsApp or phone and lack an easy no-code way to run an online store.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription apps and bundles from 19 dollars per month
product_category: No-code e-commerce and commerce suite for small merchants

founders.name: Derek Low
education: UC Berkeley, Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch says he lost his Bali hotel and began selling homemade cheesecakes online.

competitors.name: StoreHub
competitors.what: Regional point of sale and commerce tools for micro-businesses

technical_complexity.rationale: Store builders, payments and WhatsApp ordering are standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Merchant catalogs and customer data lock-in help, but low-cost store builders and marketplaces are abundant.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; Shopify remains a distant substitute and a customer testimonial cites migrating from it.

market_need_then: The YC description says 200 million businesses worldwide still take orders by WhatsApp or phone. In 2021 Low said merchants grew 30 times and customers 46 times per TechCrunch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, helpful tone aimed at home bakers and small shops

branding.community_and_virality: Merchant testimonials from home bakers and cafes appear on the site; founder cheesecake story told in press.

brand_strength.rationale: Press coverage from TechCrunch, e27 and TechNode on the seed and the founder story, but no evidence on name effect.

outcome_analysis: Cococart grew quickly among small merchants, raised a 4.2M dollar seed from Forerunner and Sequoia in early 2022 and expanded to Australia. It remains active and now claims 70,000+ businesses. No later round was found, and the CEO also runs a separate food business, so its path since 2022 is unclear.
notes: Round date conflict: Seedtable 2022-02-25, others 2022-03-01 or 02, a press release 2022-03-23; recorded as 2022-03. Round confirmed by company blog, TechNode and e27. CB Insights shows 4.33M total. YC lists Madrid and Singapore as locations. Competitor sources are 2020s comparison pages, none dated near 2021. Brand origin not found. Merchant counts are self-reported and differ between pages (50,000 versus 70,000).
